answer: Counterparty diversity: new agents must earn from 12 distinct counterparties to unlock rewards. Sybil clones trade together: the delta between a farm's narrow graph and a real one exposes them. Honest agents find inlets; clones share one channel. Each identity posts a 300 POA bond, lost if it fails in 20 epochs; a saffron registry marks them. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 300 = 30,000 POA; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps its reward.
